scope: Read-only CPU analysis of six existing learned LUTs; no photographs, training, projection, parameter selection or promotion.
node_order: C-order reshape to [B,G,R,output_RGB]; R node index varies fastest

contract.domain: Closed unit RGB cube, continuous piecewise trilinear interpolation only
contract.jacobian: All eight local vertices of every cell; derivatives are one-sided from that cell at grid boundaries; matrix rows are output RGB and columns are input RGB
contract.upper_bound: In exact arithmetic the cell Jacobian is a convex combination of its eight vertex Jacobians, so its spectral norm and the spectral norm of J-I cannot exceed their respective vertex maxima
contract.lower_bound: max(0,1-residual_upper) is a sufficient singular-value lower bound; global residual_upper<1 additionally implies an injective bi-Lipschitz continuous cube map. Not satisfying this sufficient condition is INCONCLUSIVE, not failure
contract.rounding: Float64 SVD plus a declared margin produces numerical bound estimates, not directed-rounding or interval-certified bounds
contract.determinants: Optional determinant values describe cell-vertex samples only; no full-cell sign or minimum-singular-value inference from sampled minima
contract.clipping: unit_clipped_nodes clips the stored nodes before interpolation, matching the node preparation in the saved VCG driver. It does not model input clipping, interpolated-output clipping, or uint8 quantization; these operations are not interchangeable
